You can feed SEOwind with your company data regarding your company’s unique features, products, or services and target audience. This information will be used to customize your content with SEOwind effectively.

1. **Navigate to Projects**: Start by accessing the Projects section within SEOwind. This is your starting point for managing and providing specifics about your business.
2. **Select Company Details**: Within the Projects area, look for the option labeled Company Details. This is where you’ll input information about your company.

![company details](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/Company-details-1024x486.png)

3. **Input Your Company Information**:

   - **Company Name**: Begin by entering your company’s name. This is essential for personalizing your content.
   - **Company Information**: Provide a brief overview of your company, including its background, mission, and values.
   - **Product & Service Information**: Detail the products or services you offer. Be specific about what makes them unique and valuable to your target audience.
   - **Target Audience**: Define your ideal customers. Understanding your audience is key to tailoring content that resonates with them.
4. **Save Your Details**: After filling in all the necessary information, make sure to save your data. This ensures that all the details you’ve provided are stored and ready for use.

To include your Company Details when writing an AI article, you need to toggle them within the brief.

![](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/Company-details-toggle-1024x486.png)
